end.summary:
Asha practised ordering BCE and CE dates on a timeline.
Aarav correctly placed several dates, including 500 BCE before 100 BCE and CE dates to the right.
Aarav explained that BCE numbers count down toward 1 BCE and ordered 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE, 1947 CE.
Aarav explained why historians cross-check claims against other sources.
The century for 1857 was stated as the 18th century; this was not corrected later in the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised timeline ordering, including the rule that BCE years count down toward 1 BCE, and discussed what sources show or leave out. Aarav used the method of comparing dates and explained that other sources help check a claim. There was a mix-up about finding a century from the first two digits; it was not corrected later. At home, practise placing a few BCE and CE dates on a simple left-to-right number line and finding their centuries.
